summary: Conduent Inc (CNDT) filed an 8-K announcing its wholly owned subsidiary entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its tolling solutions business to Quarterhill Inc. The purchase price is $70 million in cash plus 7% of Quarterhill's common shares (issued immediately pre-close), subject to customary adjustments. Closing is expected in Q4 2026. The board's recommendation is not stated; no advisors named. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals, third-party consents, TSX conditional listing approval, and other customary conditions. Watch for regulatory clearance and stock consideration valuation risk-arb.
